menu_option_descriptions.recognition_settings: Configure recognition mode, match threshold, confirmation and safe automatic door opening.
menu_option_descriptions.add_face: Upload a photo and add a person to the local recognition database.
menu_option_descriptions.remove_face: Remove a previously added person and the locally stored biometric descriptor.
menu_option_descriptions.background_cameras: Choose intercom cameras whose snapshots will be analyzed in the background.

recognition_settings.title: Recognition and auto-open
recognition_settings.description: Observe mode emits events but never opens the door automatically. Enable auto-open only when you understand the security implications.

data_description.recognition_mode: Controls whether recognition is off, event-only, or allowed to open the door automatically.
data_description.recognition_threshold: Dlib distance: lower values require a stricter match.
data_description.recognition_required_matches: How many consecutive frames must match the same person before confirmation.
data_description.auto_open_cooldown_seconds: Minimum time between automatic openings of the same intercom.
data_description.face_event_cooldown_seconds: Suppresses duplicate recognition events for this duration.

add_face.title: Add face

data_description.face_name: Name exposed in recognition events and the last visitor sensor.
data_description.face_image: JPG/PNG containing one clearly visible face.

data_description.face_name: The face and its biometric descriptor will be removed from the current configuration.
